about: Every artifact of the course, in generation order. Step 3 of course/PROMPTS.md resumes from the first entry whose status is not done. Statuses: todo, done, verified. week = course week (1-36); part_week = the outline id of that week. depends_on lists manifest ids: a lesson depends on the lessons its syllabus names as prerequisites (other topics in the same week only where the syllabus says so); list order is the teaching order. Paths follow course/STYLE_GUIDE.md section 5.
